However, as he realizes his ambitions, he also misses the presence of his son in his life. Having fulfilled his dream of becoming a billionaire, does life give him a second chance to be a father?

fcScore.reason: The few who rated it like it.

item.title: Mahakavya: Shri Ramayan Katha
item.review: A futuristic drama based on the story of the great epic Ramayana with the emotional filming and presentation of the events of Shri Ram's life which has never been seen on screen till now.
